message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine appropriate criminal charge(s) based on facts: illegal discharge of waste water containing heavy metals (chromium, nickel) exceeding standards, no treatment, directly discharged to sewage. This is environmental pollution crime: illegal discharge of pollutants, i.e., illegal discharge of waste water (污染环境罪). In Chinese criminal law, article 338 (Environmental Pollution Crime) includes illegal discharge of pollutants into water bodies. So the charge: “非法排放污染物” or “非法排放废水罪”. In examples, they used "非法排放污染物" maybe "非法排放废水". Look at prior examples: they had "非法捕捞水产品", "非法侵入住宅", "非法制造、买卖、运输、邮寄、储存枪支、弹药、爆炸物". For environmental, we haven't seen example. But typical label: "非法排放污染物". So answer: [罪名]非法排放污染物<eoa>.

Check if multiple charges? Only one. So final.
